build_kimi_k25_model: build a KimiK25ForConditionalGeneration multimodal model with vision tower and language model components
run_vision_encoder: run the MoonViT3dPretrainedModel vision encoder to process pixel values and return hidden states
apply_2d_rope_embedding: apply 2D rotary position embeddings to query and key tensors using precomputed freqs_cis
load_model_weights: load and map HuggingFace weights into the KimiK25 model separating vision and language components
merge_vision_patches: merge vision patch features using temporal pooling and patch merging with configurable kernel size
